response.rationale: The item is 41 days past delivery and not final-sale, so RET-008 (ineligible after 30 days) applies. Although the facts flag defective == True, the described damage resulted from the customer washing the sweatshirt twice (loss of shape, frayed cuffs from laundering), which reflects customer-caused wear rather than an inherent product defect. RET-020's higher priority only controls when a genuine defect exists; here the defect condition is not truly met on the facts, so the standard out-of-window rule governs.
